notes.title: Tester Feedback Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there bouncers![/h1]
A new update has been pushed incorporating a lot of the feedback from you all ([b]THANKYOU[/b]!!!)

[list]
[*] Simplified menu buttons (they actually look better now..)
[*] (bugfix) tile pop still playing when audio disabled in settings
[*] Enhanced visibility for interactable tiles
[*] (new feature) high score drumroll (plus awesome rumble on gamepad!)
[*] Animated score medals in level select to make it more pronounced
[*] Increased size of in-game UI elements (plus adding a bug where text rotates with arrows - lul... next update)
[*] Lowered overall volume
[/list]

[b]Thankyou again for those who tested and gave feedback, you're helping make this a fantastic little title! [/b]
